outgoing.name: Ronald Reagan
outgoing.excerpt: Days later, President Ronald Reagan declared the island as a Federal Disaster Area when requested to by Puerto Rican Governor Rafael Hernandez Colon]].

outgoing.name: United States
outgoing.excerpt: The storm's track extended from the Caribbean Sea to the southeastern United States during the second week of October.

outgoing.name: United States House of Representatives
outgoing.excerpt: Just days after the storm, the United States House of Representatives passed a resolution to provide Puerto Rico with all necessary assistance in the cleanup.
